angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 40,837,590 km at 2004.40 pc = 0.27 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TY Sct: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2004.4 +/- 151 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2004.4 +/- 151 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.3279 +/- 0.0162 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91), 20.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 58.7 +/- 4.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TY Sct: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 58.7 +/- 4.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 40,837,590 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5250 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 418, Name='TY Sct', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5250 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 418, Name='TY Sct', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5250 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 0.8 from 2023A&A...678A.195D; the 4 published values span log g 0.8 to 2.44, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.9% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A%26A...678A.195D)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
